Usage:
  prime-agent sessions delete [--dry-run] <id>...

Delete saved sessions.

Removes each session's artifacts, kernel state, log, and info cache. A live session is refused, and a list with any unknown or live id removes nothing.

Options:
  --dry-run  Show what would be removed without deleting

Examples:
  prime-agent sessions delete 01a1fb6b-cd31-7694-a622-8cbd0fa54d8d
